Subject: Consolidate renewal demo into rolling 3x30m sessions — slot compression & procurement onramp

Hi Marta / Jorge —

Thanks again for the strong engagement on the renewal — excited to get the roadmap walkthrough in front of your stakeholders. Two asks from our side while we lock the calendar:

1) We heard exec time is tight. Would your team be open to a rolling format we call a “stakeholder shuttle” — three focused 30-minute sessions (technical, product integrators, exec summary) run back-to-back the same day so we minimize cross-team scheduling friction?

2) Procurement has requested an SOW + estimated invoicing timeline before we firm the exec slot. I’m attaching a draft SOW and a compact QBR runbook that maps deliverables to the three sessions — can you confirm who on your side owns PO issuance so we can surface correct billing timelines to finance?

Proposed schedule (PST):
- 10:00–10:30 — Integration & data flow (eng lead + CI)
- 10:35–11:05 — Product roadmap & migration plan (PM + architect)
- 11:10–11:40 — Exec summary + success metrics (CRO/Head of Ops + exec sponsor)

If that works, we’ll mark the sessions as contiguous (10am–11:40am) and provide a single DocuSign envelope for SOW acceptance to speed procurement. If not, we can expand to separate windows.

Next steps: please reply with preferred date (we have 6/30, 7/7, 7/12 open) and procurement contact.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Enterprise AE
Redwood Inference
Attach: QBR-runbook-v2.pdf, SOW-draft-CLH.docx

Karthik —

Appreciate the clear proposal and the runbook. Quick answers:

- The shuttle model looks promising — it helps us keep execs in one window. We’d prefer the middle session to focus more on data residency/retention (that's our legal ask).
- Procurement contact will be Jorge (cc’d) — he’ll need the final SOW plus the payment term options (Net30 vs Net45) spelled out.

Dates: 7/7 looks best for our team. Can you confirm timezone mapping (we are EST; you referenced PST)?

Also — small ask: can you produce a condensed agenda slide that we can send to our execs (one pager with outcomes + time commitments)? That will make sign-off easier.

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Ruiz | VP Customer Success
Clearline Health
